definitions.model_step: one 50 ms model update (5 physics steps of 10 ms)
definitions.lines: every .jsonl line is one JSON object; a number that was not finite is written as null and its field's path is named in the line's nonfinite list (nonfinite_count when more than 50); a value JSON has no form for is written as its repr and named in not_json; a null with no such name is a value that was missing
definitions.steps: one line per model step k: loss (the step's total loss, the number the stats average), grad_norm (the gradient norm of the core group before the clip, as the step returns it: 0.0 when the update was skipped), group_norms (every clipping group's norm before the clip: core = every parameter outside the named groups, which are clipped on their own), clip (the clip line), nonfinite_steps (the learner's count of skipped non-finite updates so far)
definitions.replay_passes: one line per replay pass: step (the trainer's model-step counter when the pass ran; it runs after model step step-1 and its burst, before model step step), loss (the pass's total), terms (per sense the mean over the windows whose target model step is real of (prediction - next token) squared, unweighted), term_weights (the --next-frame-norm weight of each sense, when on), motor (the motor term added to the loss), grad_norm and group_norms (before the clip), stepped (whether the optimizer stepped), contract (the command contract code the pass required; null = none), windows: per window body, first (the model step of its first entry), target (of its last entry, the one predicted), contract_min and contract_max (the command contract codes of its step-from entries, limb_target_control's bits), restored (true when the window holds entries this process did not add: their model steps are read as newest - entries since, which holds when the ring took one entry per model step)
definitions.lane_persist_pe_body: [rows, bodies, senses] per model step k, body and sense: mean over the token's numbers of (older token - newer token) squared, the older token as the transformer received it (re-encoded with the command in force); NaN where the sense was not graded
definitions.lane_vision_no_copy_body: [rows, bodies] per model step k and body: vision's prediction error of the same transition with the gaze copy's term left out; equal to next_pe_body's vision column where the copy added nothing (gaze_copy_applied false)
definitions.spike_rule: one body's vision prediction error above 0.14 on 3 consecutive model steps; kept at most 3 times per launch (the count starts at 0 at every launch of the trainer), at least 300 model steps apart; refused when the drive's free space is less than the event's estimated size plus the reserve
definitions.spike_inputs: inputs_step_<k>_<launch>.pt (torch.save under a temporary name, then renamed): definitions, and per transition of the run (its model steps): prev_tokens (each sense's token of the older model step as the transformer received it), target_tokens (each sense's token of the newer model step, the lesson's target), context (the context buffer the forward pass read), memory_bias (or None), command (the 26 x 9 command in force), pose (the 26 x 10 achieved handle state of the older model step, which the gaze copy reads), prediction (each sense's prediction, the gaze copy included), vision_without_copy, raw_prev and raw_now (the older and the newer model step's raw sense inputs as the encoders received them), masks, errors and persistence (per body, vision); every tensor in its own dtype, on the processor
definitions.spike_weights: vision_spike/checkpoints/<launch>/ckpt_step_<k>: the learner's checkpoint after model step k's update (model.safetensors, optimizer.pt, runtime_state.pt, meta.json, model_receipt.json), written by LemLite.save_checkpoint into this launch's own folder, without the episode companion, by a checkpoint manager whose cleanup removes no snapshot (no keep_last_n, no registered retention); not listed in the run's checkpoints.json, so no resume reads it. Transition k was predicted with the weights before that update; transitions k-1 and k-2 with weights 1 and 2 live updates earlier still, with up to 1 replay pass between. The weights before the onset are not kept, so the model as it stood before the rise cannot be run again; the inputs file holds every captured prediction, so the differences can be measured offline.

ground.source: the learning-on measurement's model lane (next_pe_body, vision column): D:/UEMA_scratch/finger_investigation/learning_on/measure/run/arm_{control,finger,control_again}/run/observer/model, 1,000 model steps (481,800 to 482,799) x 8 bodies per run
